title: Pure UCP Maps on Finite Toeplitz Systems and Quantum Gromov--Hausdorff Convergence
summary: We study pure unital completely positive maps on the finite Toeplitz operator system $ T_{d}$ of $d \times d$ Toeplitz matrices. Our first main result gives an explicit characterization of pure UCP maps from $T_{d}$ to $M_n$ in terms of positive $n\times n$ matrix-valued trigonometric polynomials of degree at most $d-1$. This characterization provides a checkable criterion for deciding when a given UCP map is pure.
